recon_enumeration: www.defensie.nl, www.marechaussee.nl, and www.nimh.nl are Platform Rijksoverheid Online Next.js App Router/Turbopack sites. Root/search/shared framework-chunk fingerprints were normal. Search markers appeared only in serialized Next.js RSC route/query state, not an HTML or executable context.

magazines.defensie.nl and magazines.defensiedichtbij.nl serve byte-identical static kiosk exports through Azure Front Door/Blob-style infrastructure. /?s= returned the unchanged root with no marker reflection. /wp-json/ returned 404 WebContentNotFound on both; WordPress users endpoints were not requested. Sampled kiosk JS was also byte-identical and exposed no secret or first-party API.

werkenbijdefensie.nl is a custom Vue/Axios recruitment frontend behind a Google edge/application pod. Two root-linked JS files expose only a same-origin /api/v1 convention and public image helper; the API was recorded but not queried under the 2-3 GET fingerprint limit. No embedded credential/API secret was detected.

All roots returned 200. Across 20 GETs there were eighteen 200 responses and two expected wp-json 404 responses; no 403, 5xx, transport failure, PII/sensitive marker, unauthenticated administration surface, or demonstrable exposure was observed.
beeldbank.nimh.nl was explicitly blocked in the probe denylist and received zero network requests. Other linked or sibling hosts were recorded only and not requested.
